Router pricing: each model at list price.

In the router you pick the model and pay its list price; in the app you pay one rate and the assistant picks the model. Fees are shown before they apply, and every receipt names the model served.

Models · Your own key · Open models · Run it yourself · Partners

Pay as you go

Prepaid credit from $10. Adding credit costs 5 %. You pay each model's list price per million tokens; nothing is added per token.

Your own key or your own server

Bring your provider key, a subscription, or your own server (vLLM, Ollama). We route, check and record each call; the model's cost is between you and your provider.

On your own key or your own model: the first 1,000 requests a month are free on a personal account (10,000 on a team), then $1 per 1,000 requests.
